correctness.rationale: For K_theta with slices r(z)B, reflection of the upper face yields c_z >= 1/(lambda+1). Reflection of the bottom face gives -B+(lambda+1)c_x inside [lambda-(1-theta)(lambda+1)c_z]B; base asymmetry implies lambda >= q+1-theta. Explicit optimal centers satisfy every reflected-slice inclusion by convex combination of (q+1)b-B subset qB and b in B. Equality enforces the full center formula for theta<1; the prism endpoint has independent allowed height interval [1/(q+1),q/(q+1)]. Boundary theta=0/1 and q=1 handled. An independently solved 24-case vertex-facet LP agrees, but only proof establishes universality.

value.rationale: Classifies a canonical family for every convex base in all dimensions by one affine-invariant scalar and the entire center polytope. Linear interpolation and the nontrivial jump of the optimal-center locus at prism endpoint for q>1 are exact structural results, not arbitrary finite instances, renaming or arithmetic substitution.
